hypothesis: differential updates of derived graph relations for incremental recensus (P4)
blocking_question: does Atlas's actual edit-to-recensus workload need genuine incremental view maintenance across many small edits to an already-large derivation graph, or does shallow invalidation plus from-scratch recompute suffice?

measurement.workload: 23 proven self-recensus generations (G57-G79): files edited per generation 1-19 of 101-117 artifacts (median 3); artifacts semantically changed equal the edited files except in the 5 generations that changed Atlas's own analyzer (G62 24, G74 85, G75 92, G77 96, G79 23) -- a changed derivation program invalidates all derived output, which differential dataflow cannot incrementalize either (it maintains views under data change, not program change)
measurement.cost_self_scale: warm full self-recensus 7.7-8.0 s (117 artifacts, 83k graph nodes, 78k typed records); a one-file edit costs the same 7.9 s because the recensus path does not use the per-artifact extraction cache; cold vs warm `systemize --cache` differs by 3.8 s (11.1 -> 7.3 s, 96/96 cache hits), the extraction share
measurement.cost_corpus_scale: G41: full systemize of the 1,485-file rust-analyzer donor in 48.5 s; the report format, not computation, limited corpus scale (.atlas/evidence/verification/r5-corpus-scale-recensus-measurement.json)
measurement.derivation_shape: per-artifact extraction (pure, content-keyed memo, ADR 0008), one workspace-wide name-resolution fixpoint (~0.4 s), a 27-node dependency-closure fixpoint, and linear census/normalization/graph passes -- no large recursive derived relation whose incremental maintenance would need arrangements, traces or lattice-timed updates
measurement.method: recensus.json/post.json of G57-G79; wall-clock timing of recensus snapshot and cached systemize on the G79 tree

finding: shallow invalidation plus from-scratch recompute suffices: edits are small, the derivations are memoizable per artifact or cheap and linear, and the large invalidations come from analyzer changes no view-maintenance engine can avoid

REFERENCE_ONLY: collections/arrangements/traces, lattice-timed updates and iterative incremental joins (no Atlas derivation needs them at measured scale)
decision.p4_input: the self-recensus path runs without the per-artifact extraction cache (ADR 0008): wiring it would save ~3.8 s of ~7.8 s on repeated runs at one revision; cross-revision reuse still needs revision-independent batch keys (G66 P4 note)

extinction.test_dependency: none (no code or test references the checkout; not one of the DC1 real-donor Cargo workspaces)
